title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
content: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
content: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

title: German parliament proposes crypto seizures without criminal charges
content: German lawyers said a proposed law allowing the seizure of assets worth more than 100,000 euros could impose a burden of proof on crypto holders rather than the authorities.

title: Solana drops ‘beta’ label after more than six years
content: The blockchain is getting a shared version number. Wallets, transactions and apps remain unchanged.

title: Old crypto feud reignites: Why OKX's Star Xu blames Binance for two years of October crashes
content: CZ says Binance isn’t selling crypto and he has been buying. OKX founder Star Xu accuses him of misleading customers about the exchange’s role in successive October crashes.

title: Safe wallet reportedly drained of $6.5M after likely key compromise
content: Zodiac’s co-founder said a likely compromised key and overly permissive wallet settings enabled the theft, rather than a flaw in its smart contracts.

title: Bitcoin price fails to hold $65K as US stocks drop further on AI nerves
content: Bitcoin and US equities saw pressure to start the week as traders weighed the impact of forthcoming Nvidia Q3 earnings and Anthropic’s IPO announcement.

title: Zelle picks Solana for ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments
content: Zelle plans to use Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments, with confidential transfers designed to hide payment amounts.

title: Lighter pauses withdrawals after reported $10M account theft
content: Lighter has paused withdrawals after reporting a leaked trader API key, with Bubblemaps tracking $10.4 million withdrawn.

title: Saylor’s Strategy Keeps Buying Bitcoin, Adding 'A Little Orange' Through the Dip
content: The modest purchase lifted Strategy’s stash to 850,849 BTC as chairman Michael Saylor shrugged off a sharp downturn, posting that “this dip could use a little orange.”

title: 'Tokenization Is Not the Finish Line': Jupiter to Let Users Borrow Against Bullish Shares
content: The Solana trading platform unveiled a permissioned lending market, identity passport and issuer liquidity services at Breakpoint.

title: Solana Drops 'Mainnet Beta' After Six Years: Here's What 1.0 Is All About

title: DTCC, Barclays Say Tokenization's Real Prize Is Unlocking Idle Collateral
content: Executives from the U.S. settlement giant and Barclays told Solana's Breakpoint that adoption is early, but accelerating.

title: 'Nobody Knows Who's in Charge': Boris Johnson Stands by Bitcoin Skepticism at Breakpoint
content: The former UK prime minister told a Solana conference he backs blockchain but still doubts Bitcoin, months after calling it a Ponzi.

title: Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady
content: Bitcoin Magazine Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady Harvard Management Company's latest 13F shows it still holds 3,044,612 shares of BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust, unchanged since March, a stake now worth about $110.6 million after bitcoin's slide. This post Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Supreme Court Ends Custodia Bank’s Fight for a Fed Master Account, Leaving the Fed Free to Deny Crypto Banks Access
content: Bitcoin Magazine Supreme Court Ends Custodia Bank’s Fight for a Fed Master Account, Leaving the Fed Free to Deny Crypto Banks Access The Supreme Court denied Custodia Bank's petition in No. 26-62 on Monday, leaving in place a Tenth Circuit ruling that Federal Reserve Banks may reject even eligible applicants for master accounts. This post Supreme Court Ends Custodia Bank’s Fight for a Fed Master Account, Leaving the Fed Free to Deny Crypto Banks Access first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End
content: Bitcoin Magazine Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End Financial Secretary Paul Chan said Hong Kong will introduce a bill by year-end to license crypto dealers, advisers, managers and custodians, after only two of 36 first-round stablecoin applicants received licenses in April. This post Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Sweden’s H100 Taps Coinbase Prime and Deribit for Its 3,506 Bitcoin Treasury as It Courts Family Offices
content: Bitcoin Magazine Sweden’s H100 Taps Coinbase Prime and Deribit for Its 3,506 Bitcoin Treasury as It Courts Family Offices H100 Group will use Coinbase Prime and Deribit for custody, trading and financing of its roughly 3,506 BTC, worth about $226 million, as it builds bitcoin services for family offices and wealthy investors. This post Sweden’s H100 Taps Coinbase Prime and Deribit for Its 3,506 Bitcoin Treasury as It Courts Family Offices first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Strive (ASST) Buys 251 Bitcoin for $17.5 Million as Shares Drop 10% Premarket
content: Bitcoin Magazine Strive (ASST) Buys 251 Bitcoin for $17.5 Million as Shares Drop 10% Premarket Strive bought 251 bitcoin last week for $17.5 million at a $69,853 average, lifting holdings to 43,404 BTC, as shares dropped 9.5% premarket after bitcoin's weekend slide. This post Strive (ASST) Buys 251 Bitcoin for $17.5 Million as Shares Drop 10% Premarket first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
